_comment: Solana mainnet-beta. Every value starting with VERIFY must be checked against its issuer / your own records and the VERIFY prefix removed by hand; deploy and preflight refuse while any remain. Mainnet must not happen before a multi-party key ceremony and an external audit (DEPLOY.md, Before mainnet).
rpc: VERIFY: https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com (or your own paid RPC endpoint)
treasury: VERIFY: multisig (e.g. Squads vault) that receives forfeited listing bonds

prices.SOL: VERIFY: SOL price in USD at deploy time (sets the SOL-USDC / SOL-USDT launch bins)
prices.USDT: VERIFY: USDT price in USDC at deploy time (usually 1)

programs.pool: VERIFY: fresh veyl_pool program ID (npm run keys:mainnet writes it; never the repo's dev keypair)
programs.bin: VERIFY: fresh veyl_bin program ID (npm run keys:mainnet writes it; never the repo's dev keypair)
programs.entry: VERIFY: fresh veyl_entry program ID (npm run keys:mainnet writes it; never the repo's dev keypair)

postman: VERIFY: multisig or dedicated key that publishes the approved set
relayer: VERIFY: relayer hot-wallet pubkey (fee-only, low balance)

sealed._comment: Phase 3 sealed batch swaps: which bin pools get batches, and their rules. The committee comes from committee/transcript.mainnet.json (a real dealerless DKG among independent operators; preflight is red without it). VERIFY before mainnet: every value below.
